blocks.text: CAUAYAN CITY – Two government utility workers who were gathering garbage at the roadside were pinned to death after they were rammed by a van along the national road in Barangay San Fermin in Cauayan City on Thursday night. The garbage collectors had just alighted to pick up the waste bags when the speeding van crashed into them. They were officially declared dead on arrival at the Cauayan District Hospital.
